script_text: Aquarius, the Air cosmic currents are dramatically reshaping your upcoming days this week and beyond. Monday's Venus forms a challenging intense square to Saturn in your 7th House, testing relationships. Tuesday's Mercury creates a harmonious trine with Uranus in your 3rd House, sparking fresh bright ideas. Midweek Jupiter forms a very supportive sextile to your 6th House, significantly smoothing work processes. Thursday's Mars opposes your 10th House, pushing you further to boldly assert career ambitions. Friday's Moon squares your 7th House, creating deep significant tension in partnerships. Your best day is Wednesday, when Venus trines your 5th House, amplifying pure love and joy. Your worst day is Thursday, when Mars squares your 10th House, causing serious career friction. Take Tuesday's insights and apply them quickly to a concrete project early before the weekend. Follow for daily updates and let the stars always guide your week.
